concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-br-reporting-reconciliation-disbursement-report]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Brazil-route Disbursement Report version 1.1 for daily PayPal/Braintree deposit reconciliation, including the Brazil PayPal Account Number funding-account rule, merchant-account and transfer grouping, transaction-versus-settlement currency and report-event time locators, and previous-failed-disbursement carryover; not merchant pricing, current account eligibility or access, independent bank policy, or proof that a deposit arrived
warnings: Keep the route and account-routing statement specific to this captured Brazil report; do not generalize it to sibling regions or current account eligibility.
